name: Checks

# Runs on every push and pull request. The unit tests must pass. The format (StyLua) and
# lint (Selene) checks only report for now: the existing code was never run through them,
# and reformatting it is Stewart's call (see docs/PROGRESS.md).

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  tests:
    name: Unit tests (outside Studio, with Lune)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Lune 0.11.1
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
          if curl -fsSL -o /tmp/lune.zip https://github.com/lune-org/lune/releases/download/v0.11.1/lune-0.11.1-linux-x86_64.zip; then
            unzip -o /tmp/lune.zip -d "$HOME/.local/bin"
            chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/lune"
          else
            cargo install lune --version 0.11.1 --locked
          fi
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Run the specs
        run: lune run tools/test/run.luau
      - name: Economy simulation still runs
        run: python3 tools/econ/sim.py --quick --only current > /dev/null

  style:
    name: Format and lint (report only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: StyLua format check
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npx --yes @johnnymorganz/stylua-bin@2.6.0 --check src tools/test
      - name: Install Selene
        continue-on-error: true
        run: cargo install selene --version 0.31.0 --locked
      - name: Selene lint
        continue-on-error: true
        run: selene src
